content.value_statement: Long-form writing often needs structure, sources, and steady editorial feedback. This skill guides research, outlines, citations, hooks, drafts, and final review in one workflow.
actual_capabilities: Builds article, newsletter, tutorial, and thought leadership outlines from a topic and audience.
Identifies research gaps and requests credible sources for claims that need support.
Suggests stronger hooks, introductions, transitions, and titles for drafted content.
Reviews sections for clarity, flow, evidence, style, and voice match.
Formats citation plans using inline, numbered, footnote, or reference-list styles.
Provides final draft checks for structure, readability, citations, and publication readiness.
limitations: It depends on available research tools for current facts and source verification.
It does not replace legal, medical, financial, or academic expert review.
It cannot preserve voice well without writing samples or tone preferences.
It may need user review to confirm citations and quoted material are accurate.

use_cases.title: Plan a Blog Article
use_cases.description: Turn a topic, audience, and goal into a structured outline with research gaps and draft sections.

use_cases.title: Improve a Newsletter Draft
use_cases.description: Refine hooks, section flow, examples, and calls to action while keeping the writer voice consistent.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technical Education Content
use_cases.description: Create tutorial structure, add explanation checks, identify missing evidence, and review clarity before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create an outline for an article about [topic]. The audience is [audience], and the goal is [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Find Research Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this outline and identify which claims need evidence, examples, or citations. Suggest source types for each gap.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Draft Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revision for a completed section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this section for clarity, flow, evidence, and voice. Suggest specific edits without changing my main argument.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Publication Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the full draft for structure, source quality, transitions, readability, title options, and final polish priorities.

output_examples.input: I need an article outline about continuous discovery for product teams.
output_examples.output: A structured outline with a hook, introduction, three main sections, research tasks, and a conclusion path.

output_examples.input: My introduction feels weak. Can you improve the hook?
output_examples.output: Three alternative openings, each with a short explanation of audience fit and emotional impact.

output_examples.input: Review my final draft before publishing.
output_examples.output: A concise editorial review covering strengths, structure, evidence, readability, citations, and final polish actions.

best_practices: Share the audience, content goal, format, and desired tone before asking for an outline.
Keep a separate research file with source links, notes, and citation decisions.
Request feedback one section at a time before asking for a final review.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent citations or statistics without source verification.
Do not use final drafts without checking facts, quotes, and source links.
Do not expect strong voice matching without examples of your preferred style.

faq.question: Can this skill research current topics?
faq.answer: Yes, when the AI environment has current research or browsing tools. Always verify sources before publishing.

faq.question: Does it write full articles from scratch?
faq.answer: It can help draft content, but it is designed for collaborative outlining, research, feedback, and revision.

faq.question: Can it keep my writing voice?
faq.answer: Yes, it asks for tone preferences and writing samples so suggestions can match your style.

faq.question: What citation styles does it support?
faq.answer: It supports inline citations, numbered references, footnotes, and simple reference lists.

faq.question: Is it useful for technical tutorials?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline steps, review explanations, flag missing details, and check clarity.

faq.question: What should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the topic, audience, goal, draft status, source requirements, and tone preference.
